req.title: Redirect preserves relative or absolute style
req.statement: The system shall emit relative URLs on /redirect/<n> and absolute URLs on /absolute-redirect/<n>.
triggers: redirect preserves relative or absolute style

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /redirect/<n> emits relative URLs (no scheme/host) and GET /absolute-redirect/<n> emits absolute URLs (with scheme+host). The source shows redirect_n_times uses `absolute = request.args.get('absolute','false').lower() == 'true'` to switch between relative and absolute. Key mutation targets: the string comparison 'true', the boolean logic, the url_for _external flag, and the _redirect helper call. Tests cover: (1) positive EP – relative redirect for n=2 has no scheme in Location; (2) positive EP – absolute redirect via ?absolute=true has scheme in Location; (3) BVA n=1 relative – boundary where redirect goes directly to /get with relative URL; (4) BVA n=1 absolute – boundary where redirect goes directly to /get with absolute URL; (5) NEG n=0 – assert 500/assertion error; (6) DT – absolute=false explicitly still gives relative URL; (7) STC – chain of 2 relative redirects resolves correctly.

tests.name: test_redirect_n2_relative_location_has_no_scheme
expected: Location header starts with /redirect/1 (relative, no http:// prefix)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n2_relative_location_has_no_scheme():
    r = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert location.startswith('/'), f'Expected relative URL, got: {location}'
    assert not location.startswith('http://'), f'Expected relative URL, got: {location}'
    assert not location.startswith('https://'), f'Expected relative URL, got: {location}'
    assert '/redirect/1' in location, f'Expected /redirect/1 in location, got: {location}'

test_redirect_n2_relative_location_has_no_scheme()

tests.name: test_redirect_n2_absolute_location_has_scheme
expected: Location header starts with http:// (absolute URL)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: absolute URLs on /absolute-redirect/<n>; here via ?absolute=true param
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n2_absolute_location_has_scheme():
    r = client.get('/redirect/2?absolute=true', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert location.startswith('http://') or location.startswith('https://'), \
        f'Expected absolute URL with scheme, got: {location}'
    assert 'redirect' in location, f'Expected redirect path in location, got: {location}'

test_redirect_n2_absolute_location_has_scheme()

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n1_relative_goes_to_get_relative():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert location == '/get', f'Expected /get, got: {location}'
    assert not location.startswith('http'), f'Expected relative URL, got: {location}'

expected: Location is absolute URL ending in /get

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n1_absolute_goes_to_get_absolute():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1?absolute=true', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert location.startswith('http://') or location.startswith('https://'), \
        f'Expected absolute URL, got: {location}'
    assert location.endswith('/get'), f'Expected URL ending in /get, got: {location}'

tests.name: test_redirect_n0_returns_error
preconditions: n=0 violates assert n > 0 in redirect_n_times
expected: Status 500 (AssertionError triggers internal server error) or 404 if route doesn't match int:n=0
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: error pathway; n=0 should not produce a 2xx or 3xx redirect
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n0_returns_error():
    r = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code in (404, 500), \
        f'Expected 404 or 500 for n=0, got: {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 302, 'n=0 must not produce a redirect'
    assert r.status_code != 200, 'n=0 must not produce a 200 OK'

test_redirect_n0_returns_error()

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_absolute_false_explicit_gives_relative():
    r = client.get('/redirect/2?absolute=false', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert location.startswith('/'), f'Expected relative URL, got: {location}'

tests.name: test_redirect_n3_relative_chain_resolves_to_get
preconditions: n=3 triggers multi-hop relative redirect chain: /redirect/3 -> /redirect/2 -> /redirect/1 -> /get
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: STC multi-hop relative redirect chain; each hop must be relative
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n3_relative_chain_resolves_to_get():
    r = client.get('/redirect/3', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200 after following redirects, got: {r.status_code}'
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in data, f'Expected view_get JSON with url key, got: {data}'
    assert 'args' in data, f'Expected view_get JSON with args key, got: {data}'
    assert 'headers' in data, f'Expected view_get JSON with headers key, got: {data}'

test_redirect_n3_relative_chain_resolves_to_get()

tests.name: test_redirect_n2_absolute_true_location_contains_host
expected: Location contains 'localhost' or a host (absolute URL)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: DT row absolute=true n>1 -> _redirect absolute; catches _external flag mutation
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n2_absolute_true_location_contains_host():
    r = client.get('/redirect/2?absolute=true', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert '://' in location, f'Expected absolute URL with ://, got: {location}'
    assert 'localhost' in location or '127.0.0.1' in location or location.startswith('http'), \
        f'Expected host in absolute URL, got: {location}'
    assert '/redirect/1' in location, f'Expected /redirect/1 in location, got: {location}'

test_redirect_n2_absolute_true_location_contains_host()

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_boundary_minus1_is_invalid
preconditions: n=-1 is below the minimum valid value of 1
expected: Status 404 (negative int may not match route) or 500
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: BVA boundary-1 below minimum; n must be > 0
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n1_boundary_minus1_is_invalid():
    r = client.get('/redirect/-1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code in (404, 500), \
        f'Expected 404 or 500 for n=-1, got: {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 302, 'n=-1 must not produce a redirect'
    assert r.status_code != 200, 'n=-1 must not produce 200 OK'

test_redirect_n1_boundary_minus1_is_invalid()
